metaDescription: Split take-home pay into needs, wants and savings and compare your actual spending with each share. Free and private.
intro: Target amounts for needs, wants and savings, checked against the spending you paste in.
why:
The 50/30/20 rule is a simple starting point: half for needs, 30% for wants, 20% for savings and debt repayment. The shares are editable here, because high-rent cities often push needs above half.

Paste your spending as category, label and amount lines to see which category is over or under. The sheet is not stored.
howTo: Paste spending lines with need, want or save.

faq.a: Costs you must pay: housing, food, utilities, insurance, minimum debt payments, transport to work.

faq.q: Do debt repayments go in savings?
faq.a: The rule groups extra debt repayment with savings. Minimum payments count as needs.
Nothing you type leaves your browser.
